Alchemist's Lattice

An apprentice, a cracked cauldron and a lattice that hides what lies beneath. Fill rows and columns, uncover the elements, brew, battle, and earn your guild mark.

Chapter 1

The Cauldron

Spend harvested elements to learn new tile types. A type you know can turn up in any level's supply; bigger types fill lines faster, so a supply of them goes further.

Skills

Journal

Pellerin's Stall

▸ tap, click or press Space

How to Play

Drag a tile from your hand onto the lattice (or tap it, then tap where it goes). Fill a whole row or column and it clears. When all three tiles are placed, the next three come from the level's supply, which is finite: run out before the goal and the level is lost; fill the lattice so nothing fits and it jams.

  • Explore — deposits lie under stone slabs. A clear through a deposit peels off one layer; bare, it is harvested into your stores.
  • Refine — brew a potion: clear lines holding three or more of the element the recipe asks for, keep the forbidden one out, and reach its streak or double. Lines through the golden rings raise the quality more.
  • Battle — foes sit on the lattice and act when their count runs out. A clear through one cuts it back. Two lines at once cut deeper.
  • Between levels — learn tile types at the cauldron, skills with XP, and buy items from Pellerin. Each chapter allows three failed levels before its map is redrawn; you keep everything you learned.

The Guild Mark

The Ember Warden, the Dew Serpent and the Ashen Homunculus are behind you. Madame Voss sets the golden mark in your hand and a Gold cauldron at your bench, one that will take Aether.

Thank you for playing. The lattice goes on past the edge of every map: the open road waits, harder each chapter.
